message:
Add Auto Lai'tela

A toggle on Lai'tela's tab that repeats Lai'tela's Reality while each run
destabilizes it (completes in under 30 seconds) and Hadronizes when it is
fully destabilized. It stops once a run passes 30 seconds without
completing, leaving the player in that run, and logs each run instead of
showing a completion dialog for every one.
